e33chat.tutorial.title: How Templates Work
e33chat.tutorial.fields.title: How to fill
e33chat.tutorial.fields:
Fields: {display_name} display name (with titles) | {content} body | {sender}/{target} whisper sender/receiver | {sep} auto-matches >>, :, ：, » or spaces
Example: {display_name}{sep}{content} matches Steve: hello, Steve >> hello and Steve hello
Whisper: {sender}悄悄地对你说{sep}{content} matches Alex悄悄地对你说: in there?
{content} can sit anywhere (suffix styles work too); multi-colored names are handled automatically
Fill in the shape you see in chat, then verify with the preview box
e33chat.tutorial.faq.title: FAQ
e33chat.tutorial.faq:
Template never matches? Separators must match verbatim (what you type is what it matches); a title containing a colon truncates the name
Generate failed? The message must contain an online or seen player name
"Seen" = the mod remembers players you chatted with, so it recognizes them even offline
A nickname that shares no characters with the real name, while offline, may not resolve (shows grey) — known limitation
Empty template list? The guards take over, everything works as before
Permissions/file? /e33chat gui needs OP; config lives in config/e33chat-server.toml
e33chat.tutorial.why.title: How it works (brief)
e33chat.tutorial.why:
e33chat judges messages with three guards: translation keys/click events first (Guard 0), then name position + separator structure (Guard 1), finally "not sure → don't claim, show grey" (Guard 2).
A template = you declare the format: a hit splits the fields directly and skips the guard chain.
Recognition ≠ parsing: guards guess "is this a player", templates read the exact name and body.
(Does not affect usage — feel free to skip)
e33chat.server.template_n.desc: Template format: {prefix} decoration prefix, {display_name} player name (may include decorations), {content} message body (must be the last field), {sender}/{target} whisper sender/receiver. Leave the list empty to disable templates and let the guards take over.
e33chat.server.actions.desc: Add creates a blank template row. Below, the preset section offers common formats ready to add in one click.
e33chat.server.gen.desc: Paste a real chat line and generate — the template is inferred automatically (the message must contain an online or seen player name).
e33chat.server.preview.desc: Type any message to preview parsing instantly — shows the matched name and content.
e33chat.server.tpl_set_unknown_fields: Warning: unknown placeholder %s will be treated literally
e33chat.server.tpl_test_no_match: No match — the message falls back to heuristic guards
